clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says almost every sales professional he's ever met gets sales 101 wrong - and it has nothing to do with closing.

He asked a room full of career salespeople what the number one rule of selling is. Not one of them knew it. The answer, straight from Dale Carnegie: sell yourself first. Get someone to like you before you ever try to sell them anything.

How do you do that? Not by talking. By listening. You have two ears and one mouth, Kevin says - use them in that proportion.

Comment BRAIN and I'll send you Kevin's free audios on how he reads people in seconds.

Who in your life talks more than they listen?
